full_judgment: 57. In BTMC vs Nasiruddin Chowdhury cited in 5 BLC (AD) 144 the Apex in a detailed discussion accepted the position that a legitimate expectation cannot be defeated by the executive action unless public interest clearly requires negation of such expectation but of the some time found that such an expectation can be given effect to by the Court only when the facts of the case clearly and unambiguously give rise to such on expectation.
